messages:
alice: Heads-up: planning quiet-window rollout tonight 23:00 UTC for wave-27. Targets: api (v4.2.1), runtime (v7.0.0-rc2), router (v2.9.0), console (v1.13). Important: router header-split must land before kernel switch in runtime. Pin list + release notes here: https://go/release/wave-27/notes. Calling for quick compat checks and rollback gates. @deploybot please dry-run canary sequence.

bob: noted. router header-split will be the first change. I recommend router -> api -> runtime -> console ordering so header compatibility is validated early. Router owns header split rollout and verification.

carol: runtime: rc2 includes kernel batching toggle that changes KV eviction heuristics. We need a KV cache warmup window before traffic ramp. Rollback criteria from runtime side: p95 latency > 600ms for 5m or error rate x2 baseline.

dan: api team: schema is backward compatible but we need a quick contract smoke against console after router header-split. Plan canary 5% for 15m, then 30% for 10m before full shift.

maya-sre: I'll run the canary dashboards and watchpoints (latency, 5xx, cold-starts, router header mismatch). Dashboards: /dash/release/wave-27, /dash/kv/warmup. Who's the shepherd tonight?

alice: I'll shepherd. Ordering I want: 1) router header-split (bob) 2) api canary (dan) 3) runtime kernel switch + warmup (carol) 4) console deploy (small change). Keep pinned versions in deploy config. Rollback authority: owners for each service, plus me for cross-service abort.

bob: ack. router will be pinned to v2.9.0 and canaryed at 5% first. We'll emit header mismatch logs if anything falls back to old header.

carol: runtime note — please don't roll api >30% until KV warmup shows steady hit-rate > 92%. I'll post when warmup is green.

dan: we'll run the schema smoke and report pass/fail in 10m after router canary. If failure, immediate rollback of api and router pin revert.

erin: product: publish a short blurb in release notes about the kernel batching toggle and potential transient latency for some customers. Link: https://go/release/wave-27/customer-note.

maya-sre: running deploybot dry-run now. Command: ```
/deploybot dry-run --wave wave-27 --sequence router:canary5 api:canary5 runtime:canary5 console:canary5 --pins api=4.2.1 runtime=7.0.0-rc2 router=2.9.0 console=1.13
```

deploybot: dry-run accepted. Validating manifests, pins, and dependency ordering. Checking service interlocks...

deploybot: dry-run result: OK. No manifest conflicts. Suggested wait windows: router->api 3m, api->runtime 10m (warmup), runtime->console 5m.

alice: good. Let's follow those waits. @maya-sre you'll watch dashboards and call green. If any owner says rollback, we stop and revert pins.

bob: question: if router sees header backpressure we should pause and revert to v2.8.9. Is that the agreed rollback action?

carol: yes. runtime will revert to v6.12.4 if latency SLOs break.

dan: api will revert to v4.2.0 on failures.

alice: agreed. Final checks: ensure release notes link in console patch notes, update changelog, and run release-note publish at T+30. I'll start at 22:50 UTC for preflight. Everyone oncall for their service pls be available 22:50–00:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

maya-sre: I'll be on pager and will post green/abort messages here.

erin: I'll post customer note once maya posts green.

deploybot: scheduled: wave-27 rollout window 2026-04-02T23:00:00Z -> 2026-04-03T00:30:00Z. Canary schedule queued.

alice: thanks all — see you in the window.
